drhp.business: Adroit Infotech Limited provides information technology services and solutions, primarily centered on SAP consulting, implementation, and support. The company operates through a consolidated structure with key revenue-generating subsidiaries in India and overseas, catering to enterprise clients seeking digital transformation. The standalone entity in Hyderabad acts as the parent, while subsidiaries drive the majority of consolidated operations.
drhp.end_markets: Global enterprises requiring SAP and digital transformation solutions|India|Middle East (UAE)|Singapore
drhp.expansion: The Company has not disclosed any specific capacity expansion, greenfield, or brownfield capital expenditure projects with commissioning timelines in the annual report. The narrative focuses on organic growth through a larger sales force to capture market demand, with no mention of new plants, lines, or infrastructure capex plans.

litigation.note: No material litigation disclosed in the annual report.

drhp.mdna: Consolidated revenue grew significantly to Rs. 5186.53 Lakhs from Rs. 3391.16 Lakhs, driven by increased demand for digital transformation and SAP services.|Management expects continued demand for cloud migration and enterprise application services to sustain revenue growth.
drhp.one_liner: Adroit Infotech Limited is an IT solutions provider focused on SAP consulting and enterprise digital transformation, serving global clients through a network of subsidiaries in India, the UAE, and Singapore.

risks.note: Standalone revenue declined to Rs. 883.86 Lakhs while consolidated revenue surged to Rs. 5186.53 Lakhs, indicating heavy reliance on subsidiary performance; any operational or financial stress in key subsidiaries could materially impact consolidated results.

The future outlook targets consolidated revenue of Rs. 80.00 crores (approx. 54% YoY growth) through a renewed thrust with a larger sales force; failure to recruit, train, or deploy this sales force effectively could lead to missed targets and cost overruns.
risks.risk: Execution risk in scaling sales force and achieving growth targets

risks.note: 30,91,222 equity shares remain partly paid-up due to non-payment of call monies; while a final opportunity was provided, non-receipt could lead to forfeiture, dilution, or legal disputes, impacting capital structure and investor confidence.
risks.risk: Uncertainty in collection of partly paid-up share capital

risks.note: Consolidated financial cost increased from Rs. 87.90 Lakhs to Rs. 166.17 Lakhs, nearly doubling YoY; sustained increase in interest burden could erode profitability, especially if revenue growth does not compensate proportionately.
risks.risk: Margin pressure from rising financial costs

risks.note: Standalone loss after tax of Rs. 77.49 Lakhs and negative EBITDA trend (Rs. 176.94 Lakhs vs. Rs. 642.96 Lakhs) highlight structural weakness in the parent entity; persistent losses may strain liquidity and limit ability to support subsidiaries.
risks.risk: Standalone operational losses and negative profitability

drhp.strategies: Focus on SAP S/4HANA and cloud-based digital transformation services to drive growth.|Expand geographic presence and client base through strategic acquisitions and partnerships.|Strengthen recurring revenue streams via managed services and long-term support contracts.|During the year under review, the company has not declared any dividend nor transferred any amount to reserves.
drhp.strengths: Established SAP consulting practice with a multi-geography delivery footprint through subsidiaries in India, UAE, and Singapore.|Long-standing corporate history (36th Annual Report) indicating operational continuity and client relationships.
